bienvenida.why_cap: Engrama shows your review forecast for the next 30 days, so the workload never surprises you.
bienvenida.why_curve: Each timely review stretches the next interval.
bienvenida.why1: You review right before you forget|Each button shows when the card returns.
bienvenida.why2: Your data is yours|It stays on your device, no account, and you can take it anywhere.
bienvenida.why3: Saves safely|If something is cut off, it is recovered. Whatever you delete can be undone.
bienvenida.why4: Offline, no telemetry|Works without internet once installed and sends no usage data to anyone.
bienvenida.ia_t: An assistant that does the heavy lifting of studying.
bienvenida.ia_s: It reads your notes, builds the material and shows it to you before saving anything. It uses your own key and is off by default.
bienvenida.ia1: Answers from your notes|Replies with what you wrote and cites the source: the note or the PDF page.|What did I write about phase 0 in my cardiac-cycle note?
bienvenida.ia2: Makes review cards|Turns a note or a PDF into cards ready to check.|Make me 8 cards from this note.
bienvenida.ia3: Builds mock exams|Prepares questions from your notes and records the exam with its date.|Give me a 10-question mock exam on topic 3.
bienvenida.ia4: Writes full notes|Drafts the note and files it by subject.|Write a note on the AV node and file it under Physiology.
bienvenida.ia5: Draws maps and flows|Builds mind maps and flowcharts from your topic.|Draw a mind map of cardiac conduction.
bienvenida.ia6: Schedules your sessions|Plans your study sessions and moves calendar events.|Schedule two hours of review on Thursday afternoon.
bienvenida.ia7: Tidies up safely|Reorganizes your material; deletes only to the trash and only if you confirm.|Merge my two duplicate ECG notes.
bienvenida.ia8: Understands you when you talk|Voice dictation and quick actions you edit yourself.|(dictating) Make a card from what I just said.
bienvenida.ia9: Tells you what to review|Looks at your cards and exams, finds what you struggle with and builds your plan.|What should I review today?
bienvenida.ia10: Edits what you already wrote|Adds to, fixes or tags a note, a card or an exam, showing you the change first.|Add a summary at the end of my ECG note.
bienvenida.ia11: Changes the app for you|Adjusts background, colors, pomodoro and more just by asking; undo in one tap.|Set a 40-minute pomodoro and a blue background.
bienvenida.ia12: Teaches by asking|In Socratic mode it doesn't hand you the answer: it asks questions until you get there.|Explain the cardiac cycle, but quiz me with questions.

bienvenida.faq1: Do I need an account?|Not to study: you open Engrama and study. Paid plans, when they arrive, will need one.
bienvenida.faq2: Does it work offline?|Yes, fully offline once installed. Only the assistant uses the internet, and only if you turn it on with your key.
bienvenida.faq3: Where is my data kept?|On your device, and it is yours. You can back up whenever you like and restore with a preview. If you ever turn on sync with a paid plan, they will be copied to your account; it is optional.
bienvenida.faq4: What about my Anki?|You import your decks with their history if you choose, and you can export too, though export is in testing. Anki templates and styling do not come along.
bienvenida.faq5: How much does the assistant cost?|Today you use your own key from Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter or Kimi: the cost is the provider’s, and many have a free tier with limits.
bienvenida.faq6: Does it work on iPhone and Mac?|It is designed for Safari on iPad and has a phone layout. It also opens on the web. We have not tested it on every real device yet.
bienvenida.faq7: Is it an App Store app?|No: you open it in the browser and add it to your home screen.
bienvenida.faq8: How will sync and betas work?|They will be optional and only for paid plans, which come later. Today your data lives only on your device and nothing is uploaded. When it exists, you decide whether to turn it on. With a paid plan you will also be able to try new features before everyone else.
